translation: Greatly hot, slightly poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel phlegm-cold, acute twisting pain within the abdomen, various cold (bindings) and solid stasis not resolving, attack by noxious qi, heart and abdominal pain, counter-flow qi, and benefit the five [viscera]. The root bark of the white [variety] kills pinworms, treats throat impediment (喉痹) with cough and counter-flow, stops gushing diarrhea (泄注), undigested food, and women ...
